license_note: The weight repository carries LICENSE-MODEL beside the shards while repository code is governed by a separate LICENSE-CODE file in the MiniMax-M2.5 GitHub repository; the card metadata points at a plain LICENSE path the weight repository does not carry. The model license grants use, reproduction, distribution, and modification of the model materials with a retained attribution notice, subject to a prohibited-uses policy and Singapore arbitration, while the code license reproduces the MIT grant with an unconditional duty to display 'MiniMax M2.5' on any commercial product or service. Both documents keep the release source-available rather than open source.
